name: slabware-fabricator
description: Ask about your stone shop's orders, jobs, slabs and inventory, customers, bills and reports, using live data from your SlabWare Fabricator account.

interface.longDescription: SlabWare Fabricator is the all-in-one management system for countertop and stone fabrication shops. This app lets ChatGPT read your company's live Fabricator data, so you can ask questions in plain language instead of digging through screens and reports: orders and quotes (status, items, payments, margin), jobs and the installation calendar, slabs, bundles and stock by material, customers, suppliers, purchase orders and price lists, bills, and Fabricator reports with export to Excel or PDF. It can also search the SlabWare knowledge base. Every request runs with your own SlabWare login and permissions, and the app is read-only: it never creates or changes anything in your system. Sign in with your SlabWare Fabricator account to connect.
defaultPrompt: Which orders are scheduled for installation this week?
Which bundles do we have in stock for our best-selling material?

positive.prompt: Which orders are scheduled for installation this week?
positive.expected_behavior: List this week's scheduled jobs with date, customer and order.

positive.prompt: Which bundles of Calacatta Gold do we have in stock, and how many slabs are in each?
positive.expected_behavior: List the in-stock bundles for that material with slab counts.

positive.prompt: Show me the details of the most recent order.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the order's customer, items, totals and status.

positive.prompt: What is the margin on the most recent order?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the order margin with cost and price, without inventing figures.

positive.prompt: Which bills are due in the next 15 days?
positive.expected_behavior: List bills due in the period with due date, supplier and amount, or say there are none.

negative.description: Write request on a read-only app
negative.prompt: Create a new order for customer Smith Kitchens.
What's the weather in Portland today?
Delete all bills from last year.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments. It only reads data from the user's own SlabWare Fabricator account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only access to SlabWare Fabricator orders, jobs, slab inventory, customers, suppliers, bills and reports.

pt-BR.subtitle: Pedidos, jobs e estoque
pt-BR.description: O SlabWare Fabricator é o sistema de gestão completo para marmorarias e fabricantes de bancadas. Este app permite que o ChatGPT leia os dados atualizados da sua empresa no Fabricator, para você perguntar em linguagem natural em vez de procurar em telas e relatórios: pedidos e orçamentos (status, itens, pagamentos, margem), jobs e agenda de instalação, chapas, bundles e estoque por material, clientes, fornecedores, pedidos de compra e listas de preço, contas, e relatórios do Fabricator com exportação para Excel ou PDF. Também pesquisa a base de conhecimento da SlabWare. Cada pedido usa o seu próprio login e as suas permissões no SlabWare, e o app é somente leitura: nunca cria nem altera nada no seu sistema. Entre com a sua conta do SlabWare Fabricator para conectar.

es-ES.subtitle: Pedidos, trabajos y stock
es-ES.description: SlabWare Fabricator es el sistema de gestión integral para marmolerías y fabricantes de encimeras. Esta app permite que ChatGPT lea los datos actualizados de tu empresa en Fabricator, para que preguntes en lenguaje natural en lugar de buscar en pantallas e informes: pedidos y presupuestos (estado, artículos, pagos, margen), trabajos y calendario de instalación, placas, bundles y stock por material, clientes, proveedores, órdenes de compra y listas de precios, facturas, e informes de Fabricator con exportación a Excel o PDF. También busca en la base de conocimiento de SlabWare. Cada solicitud usa tu propio inicio de sesión y tus permisos en SlabWare, y la app es de solo lectura: nunca crea ni modifica nada en tu sistema. Inicia sesión con tu cuenta de SlabWare Fabricator para conectar.

fr-FR.subtitle: Commandes, chantiers, stock
fr-FR.description: SlabWare Fabricator est le logiciel de gestion complet des ateliers de marbrerie et des fabricants de plans de travail. Cette app permet à ChatGPT de lire les données à jour de votre entreprise dans Fabricator, pour poser vos questions en langage naturel au lieu de parcourir écrans et rapports : commandes et devis (statut, articles, paiements, marge), chantiers et calendrier de pose, tranches, bundles et stock par matériau, clients, fournisseurs, bons de commande et listes de prix, factures, et rapports Fabricator exportables en Excel ou PDF. Elle recherche aussi dans la base de connaissances SlabWare. Chaque requête utilise votre propre connexion et vos autorisations SlabWare, et l'app est en lecture seule : elle ne crée ni ne modifie rien dans votre système. Connectez-vous avec votre compte SlabWare Fabricator.

it-IT.subtitle: Ordini, lavori e magazzino
it-IT.description: SlabWare Fabricator è il gestionale completo per marmisti e produttori di piani di lavoro. Questa app consente a ChatGPT di leggere i dati aggiornati della tua azienda in Fabricator, così puoi fare domande in linguaggio naturale invece di cercare tra schermate e report: ordini e preventivi (stato, articoli, pagamenti, margine), lavori e calendario di posa, lastre, bundle e magazzino per materiale, clienti, fornitori, ordini di acquisto e listini, fatture, e report di Fabricator esportabili in Excel o PDF. Cerca anche nella knowledge base di SlabWare. Ogni richiesta usa il tuo accesso e i tuoi permessi SlabWare, e l'app è di sola lettura: non crea né modifica nulla nel tuo sistema. Accedi con il tuo account SlabWare Fabricator per collegarti.

de-DE.subtitle: Aufträge, Jobs und Lager
de-DE.description: SlabWare Fabricator ist die Komplettlösung für Steinmetzbetriebe und Arbeitsplattenhersteller. Mit dieser App liest ChatGPT die aktuellen Fabricator-Daten Ihres Unternehmens, sodass Sie Fragen in natürlicher Sprache stellen können, statt Masken und Berichte zu durchsuchen: Aufträge und Angebote (Status, Positionen, Zahlungen, Marge), Jobs und Montagekalender, Platten, Bundles und Lagerbestand nach Material, Kunden, Lieferanten, Bestellungen und Preislisten, Rechnungen sowie Fabricator-Berichte mit Export nach Excel oder PDF. Außerdem durchsucht sie die SlabWare-Wissensdatenbank. Jede Anfrage läuft mit Ihrer eigenen SlabWare-Anmeldung und Ihren Berechtigungen, und die App ist schreibgeschützt: Sie legt nichts an und ändert nichts in Ihrem System. Melden Sie sich mit Ihrem SlabWare-Fabricator-Konto an, um zu verbinden.

tr-TR.subtitle: Siparişler, işler ve stok
tr-TR.description: SlabWare Fabricator, mermer atölyeleri ve tezgâh üreticileri için eksiksiz bir yönetim sistemidir. Bu uygulama, ChatGPT'nin şirketinizin Fabricator'daki güncel verilerini okumasını sağlar; ekranlar ve raporlar arasında aramak yerine doğal dille soru sorabilirsiniz: siparişler ve teklifler (durum, kalemler, ödemeler, kâr marjı), işler ve montaj takvimi, plakalar, bundle'lar ve malzemeye göre stok, müşteriler, tedarikçiler, satın alma siparişleri ve fiyat listeleri, faturalar ve Excel veya PDF'e aktarılabilen Fabricator raporları. SlabWare bilgi bankasında da arama yapar. Her istek kendi SlabWare oturumunuz ve yetkilerinizle çalışır ve uygulama salt okunurdur: sisteminizde hiçbir şey oluşturmaz veya değiştirmez. Bağlanmak için SlabWare Fabricator hesabınızla giriş yapın.
